title: Evaluation Hours and Sessions Requested for a Functional Capacity Evaluation
content:
# Evaluation hours and sessions requested

**Standard.** A Functional Capacity Evaluation under a Workers' Compensation Referral is requested as a one-day evaluation of the program's maximum daily billable hours in one session.

**Hours.** The requested evaluation hours are worked out in this order: first the protocol hours are fixed, then the order re-screen hours are added, then the partial-attempt credit and the core-only reduction are taken off, and the total is never below zero.

**Sessions.** The requested evaluation sessions are two (2) for a two-day protocol — protocol hours above the program's maximum daily billable hours — and one (1) for any other protocol, and the authorization is recorded with them.

## Reading the standard

| Element | Measure |
|---|---|
| Evaluation hours | the program's maximum daily billable hours |
| Sessions | 1 |
| Floor | the requested hours are never below zero |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

For a program whose maximum daily billable hours are 4, the request is 4 evaluation hours in 1 session.
